olivia: Heads-up: Nimbus wants a Private POC. Requirements: HSM-backed root keys, KMS integration for secrets, and short-lived client certs. Who picks this up for presales?
ben: I can take it. Need a one-page checklist to send them and a recommended transfer flow (PKCS#11 over VPN preferred).
marta: Security stance: prefer PKCS#11 + attestation for anything production. For POC accept SCEP with OIDC client auth or a one-time CSR upload. Must receive CA chain and attestation evidence.
rajeev: Capacity note: Nimbus expects ~180 qps and 900 concurrent sessions. Ops estimate ~3 A100-equivalents; will fine-tune after seq-length. Pricing for 30d POC: reduced reserved commit + credits on overage.
olivia: Ben — please enumerate exact artifacts and how they should upload them. Keep it minimal to avoid churn.
ben: Draft checklist: 1) CA cert chain (PEM) 2) HSM details: vendor/model/firmware + PKCS#11 module path OR SCEP endpoint + OIDC client creds 3) KMS ARN or details if they want us to integrate with their cloud KMS for secret encryption 4) CSR if they choose manual flow 5) Management plane allowlist CIDRs + bastion jump host info 6) Bastion SSH pubkey 7) Desired cert TTL and rotation window 8) SIEM/syslog endpoint for audit forwarding
marta: Add: HSM attestation cert or TPM quote, PKCS#11 sign test (we'll send nonce), and key usage policy (non-exportable, sign/decrypt flags). Also vendor firmware version for compliance checks.
rajeev: Ask them whether they want model pinning to the Dedicated pool or fallback to hosted during overload. That changes capacity planning and the POC pricing envelope.
ben: Transport recommendations: A) PKCS#11 over customer-hosted VPN (recommended) B) SCEP + OIDC C) secure upload (S3 presigned PUTs scoped to a short prefix or scoped SFTP). For POC allow B/C but note limited attestation.
marta: Include sample PKCS#11 CSR commands to reduce back-and-forth:
```
# run on HSM host
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/<vendor>.so -l --keypairgen --key-type rsa:3072 -o priv.key --label nimbus_key
# CSR via pkcs11 engine
openssl req -engine pkcs11 -keyform engine -new -key "pkcs11:object=nimbus_key;type=private" -out nimbus.csr -subj "/CN=nimbus-client/O=Nimbus"
```
ben: What we return after validation: short-lived client certs (24h-7d), an OCSP/CRL revocation endpoint or revocation API, and a signed attestation token for their Dedicated pool.
olivia: Secure transfer: offer temporary S3 bucket with pre-signed PUTs + MFA delete, or an SFTP account scoped to /uploads/nimbus. If they require objects encrypted with their KMS CMK, accept encrypted blobs and coordinate unwrap.
rajeev: Also ask about their rotation policy and whether they allow our ephemeral CA to sign POC certs. If not, onboarding time increases.
infra-bot: :ticket: Created INF-7012 "nimbus private-poc hsm + kms onboarding" 6 assignee: ben 6 due: 3 business days 6 https://rwd.atlassian/INF-7012
marta: Security follow-ups: request ATO for POC, SOC2/ISO evidence if available, PKCS#11 test vector, and their incident/rotation plan.
ben: Timeline to Nimbus: please provide artifacts and chosen transfer method within 5 business days to keep the POC start in two weeks. I'll draft the kickoff email with the checklist and the PKCS#11 example.
olivia: Thanks — send it and cc security & solutions. I'll update the thread when Nimbus confirms S3 vs SFTP vs VPN. :rocket:
